mapper.select: SELECT cs.id, cs.sid, cs.course_id, cs.uid, cs.create_time, st.name AS student_name, cl.name AS clazz_name, c.name AS course_name, c.credit FROM course_selection cs LEFT JOIN student st ON cs.sid = st.sid LEFT JOIN clazz cl ON st.cid = cl.cid LEFT JOIN course c ON cs.course_id = c.course_id ORDER BY cs.id DESC

SELECT cs.id, cs.sid, cs.course_id, cs.uid, cs.create_time, st.name AS student_name, cl.name AS clazz_name, c.name AS course_name, c.credit FROM course_selection cs LEFT JOIN student st ON cs.sid = st.sid LEFT JOIN clazz cl ON st.cid = cl.cid LEFT JOIN course c ON cs.course_id = c.course_id WHERE cs.sid = #{sid} ORDER BY cs.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_selection (sid, course_id, uid, create_time) VALUES (#{sid}, #{courseId}, #{uid}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_selection WHERE sid = #{sid} AND course_id = #{courseId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student WHERE sid = #{sid}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE course_id = #{courseId}

SELECT c.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, a.week_day AS weekDay, a.section AS section FROM course_selection cs LEFT JOIN course c ON cs.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN course_arrange a ON cs.course_id = a.course_id WHERE cs.sid = #{sid} AND a.arrange_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT course_id FROM course_selection WHERE sid = #{sid}
